items.claim: CFO 說明財測做法：拿長期觀察到的成長率，再打折留緩衝。
items.quote: we take that growth rate that we see over a long period
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱過去 beat and raise 的實績是客戶實際支出高於財測扣掉的折數。
items.quote: spend more than the amount we're discounting
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱公司每天看得到客戶用量，稱之為近乎完整的資訊（作為財測依據）。
items.quote: So it's almost perfect information.
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱每天早上醒來就能按客戶切分看到用量。
items.quote: I can see the usage when I wake up in the morning
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: 分析師在提問中描述公司目前自由現金流在高 20% 區間（分析師口述，非管理層）。
items.quote: free cash flow in the high 20s
items.speaker: William Kingsley Crane

items.claim: CFO 稱利潤率沒有變化。
items.quote: You can see our margins haven't changed, right?
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 把 token 支出描述為資源重新分配，而非利潤率侵蝕。
items.quote: it's more of a distribution than a margin erosion
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱研發投入的配置會更偏向 token，而非人力。
items.quote: is going to move more towards tokens than it is to humans
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明淨留存率的口徑：講的是 120% 出頭（low 120s）。
items.quote: net retention that we talked about in the 120s, low 120s
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明多產品採用數（cross-sell 指標）的口徑：每年擴大定義。
items.quote: we expand the definition of cross-sell
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱銷售產能會繼續投資。
items.quote: So that we're going to continue to invest in.
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱研發會以高比率持續投入。
items.quote: invest at a high rate, but it's very likely
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明揭露慣例：不預告某產品會做到 $1 billion。
items.quote: We don't go like we're going to have $1 billion of this
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明揭露慣例：達到某個量級後才對外公布。
items.quote: when we get to certain amounts, we tell everybody
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 劃定安全產品範圍：不做桌面安全。
items.quote: we're not saying we're going to secure desktops
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱全球銷售配額產能已成功擴張。
items.quote: successfully ramped quota capacity on a global basis
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱配額產能的擴張幅度與營收大致相當。
items.quote: it's been roughly in line with revenues
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱市場尚未飽和，銷售仍有拓展空間。
items.quote: we're not at the point where we saturated the market
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 提到公司剛完成一筆收購（分析師後續提問稱之為 Adaptive ML 研究實驗室，該名稱為分析師以 I think 帶出）。
items.quote: We just made an acquisition.
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱平台整合帶動交叉銷售與搶市占。
items.quote: That's enabled us to cross-sell and also take market share
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱上一季營收環比增加 $115 million。
items.quote: I think we said sequentially, we grew $115 million of
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 把該季度增量以季度基礎看作超過 $400 million 的業務規模，並拿來與競爭對手比較。
items.quote: think of that as over $400 million of business
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱與競爭對手相比，市占增幅非常大。
items.quote: the market share gains are very substantial
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱大客戶自建與外購並存，但整體淨傾向是買 Datadog。
items.quote: towards not doing it yourself but buying Datadog
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱公司從零成長到超過 $4.5（下一行接 billion）；原文未標明是營收或 ARR。
items.quote: That's what's produced from 0 Datadog to over $4.5
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱在 observability 領域有很大的競爭優勢，不是在通用模型訓練上。
items.quote: there's just a tremendous competitive advantage
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱他人跨界進攻（Snowflake、Palo Alto、Splunk 之類）並未改變競爭態勢。
items.quote: And it hasn't changed the competitive dynamic
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱對這段期間來說，結果是 Datadog 的競爭地位增強而非削弱。
items.quote: a strengthening of the competitive position of Datadog
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱目前主要監控生產環境，並開始做更多訓練端的監控。
items.quote: We're starting to do more in training.
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 AI 監控（Datadog for AI）領域成長良好。
items.quote: we've been seeing very good growth in that area
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 指出已對外揭露的 AI 指標包括 agent 監控與 MCP 呼叫成長。
items.quote: the growth of agent monitoring, the growth of MCP calls
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱這些指標成長率很高，但仍在早期。
items.quote: these things are growing at a very high rate
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 AI 監控的變現方式是產品 GA 時公布定價。
items.quote: monetizing it through pricing we publish as we put into GA
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 AI for Datadog（Bits）有動能，管理層持樂觀態度。
items.quote: we're seeing traction in that, which we're optimistic
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱推動需求的是客戶把 LLM 應用放上生產環境。
items.quote: clients are putting LLM-enabled applications in production
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱公司投資於 observability 專用的智能。
items.quote: specialized intelligence that we're investing in
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 描述產品方向是往自我修復（self-remediation）走。
items.quote: something that's going to move towards self-remediation
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 承認自我修復尚未達成，仍在路上。
items.quote: We're not quite there yet, but that's what the vision is
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 Bits 的定價正在試驗（與分析師所述的按調查計價轉為按 token 計價有關）。
items.quote: We play around with pricing
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 Bits 新定價早期反應與使用良好。
items.quote: early signs are a lot of good reception and use
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 Bits 從可靠性調查擴展到安全與軟體開發。
items.quote: we're also investing in security and software creation
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱安全業務聚焦在雲端工作負載相關領域。
items.quote: working on the security of modern cloud workloads
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 承認疫後 ZIRP 時期曾有一些過度使用。
items.quote: was probably some usage that was over usage
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 承認 AI 原生客群可能有波動。
items.quote: is there going to be volatility there? Yes, there might be
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱公司不是按席位計價，模式與工作負載由 agent 或人處理無關。
items.quote: we're not a seat model
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱收費依據是流經平台的工作負載。
items.quote: monetizing based on the workloads that go through
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱客戶端有強勁的平台投資，部分是為了 AI 做準備。
items.quote: there's a strong investment in platform right now
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 回答非 AI 原生客群時稱，企業客戶的加速已進入 upper 20s。
items.quote: upper 20s, and that's enterprises and stuff
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 AI 原生客戶名單分散：750 個以上，其中 30 個以上超過 $1 million。
items.quote: We had over 750 names, over 30 of them having $1 million
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 稱 AI 原生客群佔 ARR 的比重比疫情高峰時小得多。
items.quote: a much smaller group as a percentage of ARR
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明合約結構：採 take-or-pay 合約。
items.quote: we have take-or-pay contracts
items.speaker: David Obstler

items.claim: CFO 說明合約設有基本承諾額，客戶不能低於該額度。
items.quote: we have a base of commitment, so they can't spend less
items.speaker: David Obstler

qa_flags.question: 分析師問 agent 流量占比上升後，這塊業務可能做到多大、客戶是否在改變。
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 沒給任何規模數字，回答為「Where it's going to wind up, I don't know」，改談 Datadog 不是按席位計價。
